hook_text: At the very top of the throw the ball stops — but gravity never does. The trap that catches thousands, named and disarmed.
clip_script: Trap one: the top of the flight. Velocity is zero there, and the trap whispers that acceleration is too — it is not; gravity works full shifts, 9,8 metres per second squared, all the way up and all the way down. Trap two: the missing sign convention. Momentum and projectile answers collapse when up and down, towards and away, are never declared; write the chosen positive direction before the first substitution, every time.
visual_style: A ball rising in slow motion, freezing at the top with 'v = 0' stamped beside it — then a persistent red arrow labelled '9,8' pointing down through the freeze, refusing to disappear.
mood: Myth-busting confidence — the trap named out loud before it can bite.
pacing: Slow rise, dramatic freeze at the top, the arrow pulsing, then a rapid-fire list of the remaining traps.
call_to_action: Sweep the whole physics core — laws, ledgers and traps — in the full revision session.
